causal_ordering.prediction_time: one minute before the registered half-hour begins
causal_ordering.entry_time: the registered half-hour's first M1 open
causal_ordering.historical_slot_inputs: complete matching half-hours from prior sessions only
causal_ordering.current_session_inputs: complete M1 bars strictly before the prediction timestamp

feature_policy.same_slot_persistence: positive shares over 5, 20, and up to 40 sessions
feature_policy.cross_section: lag 1/5/20 ranks and lag-1 dispersion with candidate excluded
feature_policy.current_context: pre-slot return, candidate-excluded rank, and breadth
feature_policy.participation: historical same-slot volume ratio and turnover
feature_policy.execution: prior daily median turnover, impact proxy, and modeled round-trip cost

opportunity_policy.lag1_cross_sectional: positive lag-1 same-slot return and upper-decile candidate-excluded rank
opportunity_policy.multi_day_persistence: positive lag-20 mean, at least 65% positive lag-20 slots, and upper-decile lag-20 rank

verified_behaviors: the computed vector exactly matches all 24 frozen feature names
the candidate is excluded from every peer statistic
mutating the predicted slot or later candidate bars cannot change features or calls
mutating future peer and daily rows cannot change features
fewer than 20 historical slots or 30 valid peers fails closed
a missing pre-decision bar fails closed
only registered half-hour starts are accepted
entry occurs after the prediction at the next slot open
target returns include slippage and actual Indian cost-model charges
same-bar target and stop touches are losses
missing entry or outcome bars never become wins
zero entry volume is explicitly unfilled
a time exit is never promoted to strict target success
bars after the frozen slot cannot rewrite an outcome
strategy and engine contract mismatches fail closed

decision.reason: Milestone 1 implements and tests causal features, opportunity rules, and conservative outcomes only. No real SSM population, mechanism estimate, selector race, accuracy result, or aggregate after-cost performance exists yet.
